programs.source:
void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool has_text(string[] choices, string value)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

error logo_error(nat line, string reason)
    return error("ERROR line {line}: " + reason)

string upper_ascii(string text)
    result := ""
    lower := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    upper := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    for: i < #text
        match lower.find(text[i])
            nat at
                result += upper[at]
            none
                result += text[i]
    return result

bool name_valid(string text)
    if text == "" or not "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(text[0])
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

bool digits(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

string canonical_name(string name)
    aliases := ["FORWARD", "BACK", "RIGHT", "LEFT", "SETHEADING", "PENUP", "PENDOWN", "PENERASE", "CLEARSCREEN", "IFT", "IFF", "OP", "PR"]
    originals := ["FD", "BK", "RT", "LT", "SETH", "PU", "PD", "PE", "CS", "IFTRUE", "IFFALSE", "OUTPUT", "PRINT"]
    for: i < #aliases
        if aliases[i] == name
            return originals[i]
    return name

string command_inputs(string name)
    if has_text(["FD", "BK", "RT", "LT", "SETH", "SETPEN", "SETX", "SETY", "TEST", "OUTPUT", "SEED"], name)
        return "E"
    if has_text(["PU", "PD", "PE", "HOME", "CS", "CLEAN", "FILL", "SNAPSHOT", "STOP"], name)
        return ""
    if name == "SETXY"
        return "EE"
    if name == "LABEL" or name == "PRINT"
        return "P"
    if has_text(["REPEAT", "WHILE", "IF"], name)
        return "EL"
    if name == "FOR"
        return "QEEL"
    if name == "IFELSE"
        return "ELL"
    if name == "IFTRUE" or name == "IFFALSE"
        return "L"
    if name == "MAKE" or name == "LOCALMAKE"
        return "QE"
    if has_text(["LOCAL", "TRACE", "UNTRACE"], name)
        return "Q"
    return "?"

int function_arity(string name)
    if has_text(["XCOR", "YCOR", "HEADING", "REPCOUNT"], name)
        return 0
    if has_text(["RANDOM", "ABS", "NOT"], name)
        return 1
    if has_text(["AND", "OR", "MAX", "MIN"], name)
        return 2
    return -1

bool primitive(string name)
    return command_inputs(canonical_name(name)) != "?" or function_arity(name) >= 0 or has_text(["TO", "END", "MOD"], name)

class SourceLine(nat number, string text)
class Token(nat kind, string spelling, nat line, value := "")
class Node(nat kind, string text, string spelling, nat line, value := 0, nat[] children := [])
class Procedure(string name, string[] parameters, nat line)
    Token[] tokens := []
    nat body := 0
class BuiltProgram(Procedure[] definitions, Node[] pool, nat top)
class Flow(nat kind := 0, value := 0)
class OutputValue(bool has_value, int value)
class Point(int x, int y)
class Bounds(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)
class LogoEnvironment(string procedure_name)
    variables := map<string, int>()
    test_result := -1

int procedure_index(Procedure[] definitions, string name)
    for: i < #definitions
        if definitions[i].name == name
            return int(i)
    return -1

Token | error classify(string lexeme, nat line)
    if digits(lexeme)
        return Token(0, lexeme, line, lexeme)
    if name_valid(lexeme)
        return Token(3, lexeme, line, lexeme)
    if (lexeme[0] == ":" or lexeme[0] == DQ) and name_valid(lexeme[1:])
        return Token(if lexeme[0] == ":" then 1 else 2, lexeme, line, lexeme[1:])
    return logo_error(line, "bad token '" + lexeme + "'")

Token[] | error tokenize(string source, nat line)
    text := upper_ascii(source.split(";")[0])
    delimiters := " []()+-*/=<>"
    Token[] result := []
    nat i := 0
    while i < #text
        character := text[i]
        following := if i + 1 < #text then text[i + 1] else ""
        if character == " "
            i += 1
        elif character == "-"
            starts_term := i == 0 or " [(".contains(text[i - 1])
            sign := starts_term and following != "" and following != " "
            result = result.append(Token(if sign then 5 else 4, "-", line))
            i += 1
        elif character == "<" or character == ">"
            pair := character + following
            spelling := if has_text(["<=", "<>", ">="], pair) then pair else character
            result = result.append(Token(4, spelling, line))
            i += #spelling
        elif delimiters.contains(character)
            result = result.append(Token(4, character, line))
            i += 1
        else
            start := i
            while i < #text and not delimiters.contains(text[i])
                i += 1
            result = result.append(try classify(text[start:<i], line))
    return result

class Parser()
    Procedure[] definitions := []
    Token[] top_tokens := []
    Node[] pool := []
    Token[] tokens := []
    nat position := 0
    in_procedure := false

    void | error .extract(SourceLine[] source)
        current := -1
        for entry := source[]
            line_tokens := try tokenize(entry.text, entry.number)
            if #line_tokens == 0
                continue
            if line_tokens[0].kind == 3 and line_tokens[0].spelling == "TO"
                if current >= 0
                    return logo_error(entry.number, "TO inside definition of " + definitions[current].name)
                if #line_tokens < 2 or line_tokens[1].kind != 3
                    return logo_error(entry.number, "bad procedure header")
                name := line_tokens[1].spelling
                if primitive(name)
                    return logo_error(entry.number, name + " is a primitive")
                if procedure_index(definitions, name) >= 0
                    return logo_error(entry.number, name + " is already defined")
                string[] parameters := []
                for token := line_tokens[2:][]
                    if token.kind != 1
                        return logo_error(entry.number, "bad procedure header")
                    if has_text(parameters, token.value)
                        return logo_error(entry.number, "duplicate input " + token.spelling)
                    parameters = parameters.append(token.value)
                current = int(#definitions)
                definitions = definitions.append(Procedure(name, parameters, entry.number))
            elif #line_tokens == 1 and line_tokens[0].kind == 3 and line_tokens[0].spelling == "END"
                if current < 0
                    return logo_error(entry.number, "END without TO")
                current = -1
            elif current >= 0
                definitions[current].tokens = definitions[current].tokens.concat(line_tokens)
            else
                top_tokens = top_tokens.concat(line_tokens)
        if current >= 0
            return logo_error(definitions[current].line, "missing END for " + definitions[current].name)
        return void

    Token peek()
        return if position < #tokens then tokens[position] else Token(6, "", 0)

    Token .advance()
        result := tokens[position]
        position += 1
        return result

    bool next_is(string[] spellings)
        Token token := peek()
        return token.kind != 6 and token.kind != 5 and has_text(spellings, token.spelling)

    bool unknown(Token token)
        return token.kind == 3 and not primitive(token.spelling) and procedure_index(definitions, token.spelling) < 0

    Token | error input_token(Token owner)
        Token token := peek()
        if token.kind == 6 or token.spelling == "]" or token.spelling == ")"
            return logo_error(owner.line, "not enough inputs to " + owner.spelling)
        if unknown(token)
            return logo_error(token.line, "I don't know how to " + token.spelling)
        return token

    nat .add_node(Node node)
        index := #pool
        pool = pool.append(node)
        return index

    nat | error .parse_sequence()
        nat[] commands := []
        while peek().kind != 6
            if peek().spelling == "]"
                return logo_error(peek().line, "unexpected ]")
            commands = commands.append(try .parse_command())
        return .add_node(Node(6, "", "", 0, children = commands))

    nat | error .parse_list()
        Token opening := .advance()
        nat[] commands := []
        while not next_is(["]"])
            if peek().kind == 6
                return logo_error(opening.line, "missing ]")
            commands = commands.append(try .parse_command())
        .advance()
        return .add_node(Node(6, "", "", opening.line, children = commands))

    nat | error .parse_input(Token owner, string kind)
        Token token := try input_token(owner)
        if kind == "L" and token.spelling == "["
            return .parse_list()
        if (kind == "Q" or kind == "P") and token.kind == 2
            .advance()
            return .add_node(Node(2, token.value, token.spelling, token.line))
        if kind == "E" or kind == "P"
            return .parse_expression(owner)
        return logo_error(token.line, owner.spelling + " doesn't like " + token.spelling + " as input")

    nat | error .parse_call(Token token, nat arity)
        nat[] inputs := []
        for: i < arity
            inputs = inputs.append(try .parse_expression(token))
        return .add_node(Node(5, token.spelling, token.spelling, token.line, children = inputs))

    nat | error .parse_command()
        Token token := .advance()
        if token.spelling == "(" and next_is(["PRINT", "PR"])
            Token word := .advance()
            nat[] inputs := []
            while not next_is([")"])
                if peek().kind == 6 or next_is(["]"])
                    return logo_error(token.line, "missing )")
                inputs = inputs.append(try .parse_input(word, "P"))
            .advance()
            return .add_node(Node(5, "PRINT", word.spelling, token.line, children = inputs))
        if token.kind == 3
            name := canonical_name(token.spelling)
            if name == "TO" or name == "END"
                return logo_error(token.line, "misplaced " + name)
            signature := command_inputs(name)
            if signature != "?"
                if not in_procedure and has_text(["STOP", "OUTPUT", "LOCAL", "LOCALMAKE"], name)
                    return logo_error(token.line, "can only use " + token.spelling + " inside a procedure")
                nat[] inputs := []
                for: i < #signature
                    inputs = inputs.append(try .parse_input(token, signature[i]))
                if name == "TRACE" or name == "UNTRACE"
                    quoted := pool[inputs[0]]
                    if procedure_index(definitions, quoted.text) < 0
                        return logo_error(quoted.line, "I don't know how to " + quoted.text)
                return .add_node(Node(5, name, token.spelling, token.line, children = inputs))
            index := procedure_index(definitions, name)
            if index >= 0
                return .parse_call(token, #definitions[index].parameters)
            if unknown(token)
                return logo_error(token.line, "I don't know how to " + name)
        return logo_error(token.line, "you don't say what to do with " + token.spelling)

    nat | error .parse_expression(Token owner, nat level := 0)
        if level == 3
            return .parse_term(owner)
        string[][] levels := [["=", "<>", "<", ">", "<=", ">="], ["+", "-"], ["*", "/", "MOD"]]
        nat left := try .parse_expression(owner, level + 1)
        while next_is(levels[level])
            Token op := .advance()
            nat right := try .parse_expression(op, level + 1)
            left = .add_node(Node(4, op.spelling, op.spelling, op.line, children = [left, right]))
        return left

    nat | error .parse_term(Token owner)
        Token token := try input_token(owner)
        .advance()
        if token.kind == 0
            return .add_node(Node(0, "", token.spelling, token.line, int(token.value)))
        if token.kind == 1
            return .add_node(Node(1, token.value, token.spelling, token.line))
        if token.spelling == "-"
            nat operand := try .parse_term(token)
            return .add_node(Node(3, "", "-", token.line, children = [operand]))
        if token.spelling == "("
            nat expression := try .parse_expression(token)
            if not next_is([")"])
                return logo_error(token.line, "missing )")
            .advance()
            return expression
        arity := function_arity(token.spelling)
        if arity >= 0
            return .parse_call(token, nat(arity))
        index := procedure_index(definitions, token.spelling)
        if index >= 0
            return .parse_call(token, #definitions[index].parameters)
        return logo_error(token.line, owner.spelling + " doesn't like " + token.spelling + " as input")

    BuiltProgram | error .build(SourceLine[] source)
        try .extract(source)
        for: i < #definitions
            tokens = definitions[i].tokens
            position = 0
            in_procedure = true
            definitions[i].body = try .parse_sequence()
        tokens = top_tokens
        position = 0
        in_procedure = false
        nat top := try .parse_sequence()
        return BuiltProgram(definitions, pool, top)

int floor_divide(int numerator, int denominator)
    quotient := numerator / denominator
    return if numerator < 0 and numerator % denominator != 0 then quotient - 1 else quotient

string cell_key(int x, int y)
    return "{x},{y}"

string ascii_character(int code)
    string alphabet := "!" + DQ + "#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"
    return alphabet[code - 33]

class Runtime(BuiltProgram program)
    turtle_x := 0
    turtle_y := 0
    heading := 0
    pen_state := "DOWN"
    pen_character := "*"
    canvas := map<string, string>()
    environments := [LogoEnvironment("")]
    int[] repcounts := []
    string[] traced := []
    random_state := 1

    int | error lookup(Node node)
        for: #environments > i >= 0
            match environments[i].variables.get(node.text)
                int value
                    return value
                none
                    void
        return logo_error(node.line, node.text + " has no value")

    void .make_variable(string name, int value)
        for: #environments > i >= 1
            match environments[i].variables.get(name)
                int old
                    .environments[i].variables.set(name, value)
                    return
                none
                    void
        .environments[0].variables.set(name, value)

    OutputValue | error .call_procedure(Node call)
        index := procedure_index(program.definitions, call.text)
        procedure := program.definitions[index]
        int[] values := []
        for argument := call.children[]
            values = values.append(try .evaluate(argument))
        depth := #environments - 1
        if depth >= 100
            return logo_error(call.line, "recursion too deep")
        trace_call := has_text(traced, procedure.name)
        string indent := " " * (depth * 2)
        if trace_call
            emit(indent + "( " + [procedure.name].concat([for value := values[] then string(value)]).join(" ") + " )")
        scope := LogoEnvironment(procedure.name)
        for: i < #values
            .scope.variables.set(procedure.parameters[i], values[i])
        environments = environments.append(scope)
        Flow outcome := try .run_list(procedure.body)
        environments = environments[:<#environments - 1]
        if trace_call
            emit(indent + procedure.name + (if outcome.kind == 2 then " outputs {outcome.value}" else " stops"))
        return OutputValue(outcome.kind == 2, outcome.value)

    int | error .evaluate(nat index)
        node := program.pool[index]
        if node.kind == 0
            return node.value
        if node.kind == 1
            return lookup(node)
        if node.kind == 3
            return -(try .evaluate(node.children[0]))
        if node.kind == 4
            int a := try .evaluate(node.children[0])
            int b := try .evaluate(node.children[1])
            op := node.text
            if op == "/" or op == "MOD"
                if b == 0
                    return logo_error(node.line, op + " doesn't like 0 as input")
                return if op == "/" then a / b else a % b
            if op == "+"
                return a + b
            if op == "-"
                return a - b
            if op == "*"
                return a * b
            result := if op == "=" then a == b else (if op == "<>" then a != b else (if op == "<" then a < b else (if op == ">" then a > b else (if op == "<=" then a <= b else a >= b))))
            return if result then 1 else 0
        if procedure_index(program.definitions, node.text) >= 0
            OutputValue result := try .call_procedure(node)
            if not result.has_value
                return logo_error(node.line, node.text + " did not output")
            return result.value
        int[] arguments := []
        for argument := node.children[]
            arguments = arguments.append(try .evaluate(argument))
        name := node.text
        if name == "XCOR"
            return turtle_x
        if name == "YCOR"
            return turtle_y
        if name == "HEADING"
            return heading
        if name == "REPCOUNT"
            if #repcounts == 0
                return logo_error(node.line, "REPCOUNT outside REPEAT")
            return repcounts[-1]
        if name == "RANDOM"
            if arguments[0] < 1
                return logo_error(node.line, node.spelling + " doesn't like {arguments[0]} as input")
            random_state = random_state * 48271 % 2147483647
            return random_state % arguments[0]
        if name == "ABS"
            return absolute(arguments[0])
        if name == "NOT"
            return if arguments[0] == 0 then 1 else 0
        if name == "AND"
            return if arguments[0] != 0 and arguments[1] != 0 then 1 else 0
        if name == "OR"
            return if arguments[0] != 0 or arguments[1] != 0 then 1 else 0
        return if name == "MAX" then maximum(arguments[0], arguments[1]) else minimum(arguments[0], arguments[1])

    string | error .print_item(nat index)
        node := program.pool[index]
        return if node.kind == 2 then node.text else string(try .evaluate(index))

    void .apply_pen(int x, int y)
        if pen_state == "DOWN"
            .canvas.set(cell_key(x, y), pen_character)
        elif pen_state == "ERASE"
            .canvas.remove(cell_key(x, y))

    Point direction()
        directions := [Point(0, 1), Point(1, 1), Point(1, 0), Point(1, -1), Point(0, -1), Point(-1, -1), Point(-1, 0), Point(-1, 1)]
        return directions[heading / 45]

    void .forward(int amount)
        Point delta := direction()
        if amount < 0
            delta.x = -delta.x
            delta.y = -delta.y
            amount = -amount
        .apply_pen(turtle_x, turtle_y)
        for: i < amount
            turtle_x += delta.x
            turtle_y += delta.y
            .apply_pen(turtle_x, turtle_y)

    void .move_to(int x, int y)
        dx := x - turtle_x
        dy := y - turtle_y
        steps := maximum(absolute(dx), absolute(dy))
        if steps == 0
            .apply_pen(turtle_x, turtle_y)
        else
            for: i <= steps
                .apply_pen(turtle_x + floor_divide(2 * i * dx + steps, 2 * steps), turtle_y + floor_divide(2 * i * dy + steps, 2 * steps))
        turtle_x = x
        turtle_y = y

    bool marked(int x, int y)
        match canvas.get(cell_key(x, y))
            string character
                return true
            none
                return false

    Bounds canvas_bounds()
        keys := canvas.keys()
        first := keys[0].split(",")
        result := Bounds(int(first[0]), int(first[1]), int(first[0]), int(first[1]))
        for key := keys[]
            coordinates := key.split(",")
            x := int(coordinates[0])
            y := int(coordinates[1])
            result.x1 = minimum(result.x1, x)
            result.y1 = minimum(result.y1, y)
            result.x2 = maximum(result.x2, x)
            result.y2 = maximum(result.y2, y)
        return result

    void .fill_canvas()
        if #canvas.keys() == 0 or marked(turtle_x, turtle_y)
            return
        Bounds bounds := canvas_bounds()
        if turtle_x < bounds.x1 or turtle_x > bounds.x2 or turtle_y < bounds.y1 or turtle_y > bounds.y2
            return
        pending := [Point(turtle_x, turtle_y)]
        .canvas.set(cell_key(turtle_x, turtle_y), pen_character)
        while #pending != 0
            current := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[:<#pending - 1]
            for next := [Point(current.x - 1, current.y), Point(current.x + 1, current.y), Point(current.x, current.y - 1), Point(current.x, current.y + 1)][]
                if next.x >= bounds.x1 and next.x <= bounds.x2 and next.y >= bounds.y1 and next.y <= bounds.y2 and not marked(next.x, next.y)
                    .canvas.set(cell_key(next.x, next.y), pen_character)
                    pending = pending.append(next)

    void write_canvas()
        keys := canvas.keys()
        if #keys == 0
            emit("CANVAS 0 0 0")
            return
        Bounds bounds := canvas_bounds()
        emit("CANVAS {bounds.x2 - bounds.x1 + 1} {bounds.y2 - bounds.y1 + 1} {#keys}")
        for: bounds.y2 >= y >= bounds.y1
            row := ""
            for: bounds.x1 <= x <= bounds.x2
                match canvas.get(cell_key(x, y))
                    string character
                        row += character
                    none
                        row += " "
            while #row > 0 and row[#row - 1] == " "
                row = row[:<#row - 1]
            emit(row)

    Flow | error .run_list(nat index)
        for command := program.pool[index].children[]
            Flow signal := try .execute(command)
            if signal.kind != 0
                return signal
        return Flow()

    Flow | error .execute(nat index)
        command := program.pool[index]
        name := command.text
        inputs := command.children
        if procedure_index(program.definitions, name) >= 0
            OutputValue result := try .call_procedure(command)
            if result.has_value
                return logo_error(command.line, "you don't say what to do with {result.value}")
            return Flow()
        if name == "FD" or name == "BK"
            int value := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            .forward(if name == "FD" then value else -value)
        elif has_text(["RT", "LT", "SETH"], name)
            int angle := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            if angle % 45 != 0
                return logo_error(command.line, command.spelling + " doesn't like {angle} as input")
            value := if name == "SETH" then angle else heading + (if name == "RT" then angle else -angle)
            heading = (value % 360 + 360) % 360
        elif name == "PU" or name == "PD" or name == "PE"
            pen_state = if name == "PU" then "UP" else (if name == "PD" then "DOWN" else "ERASE")
        elif name == "SETPEN"
            int code := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            if code < 33 or code > 126
                return logo_error(command.line, command.spelling + " doesn't like {code} as input")
            pen_character = ascii_character(code)
        elif name == "SETXY"
            int x := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            int y := try .evaluate(inputs[1])
            .move_to(x, y)
        elif name == "SETX"
            int x := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            .move_to(x, turtle_y)
        elif name == "SETY"
            int y := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            .move_to(turtle_x, y)
        elif name == "HOME"
            .move_to(0, 0)
            heading = 0
        elif name == "CS" or name == "CLEAN"
            canvas = map<string, string>()
            if name == "CS"
                turtle_x = 0
                turtle_y = 0
                heading = 0
        elif name == "FILL"
            .fill_canvas()
        elif name == "LABEL"
            string text := try .print_item(inputs[0])
            Point delta := direction()
            for: i < #text
                .canvas.set(cell_key(turtle_x + int(i) * delta.x, turtle_y + int(i) * delta.y), text[i])
        elif name == "SNAPSHOT"
            write_canvas()
        elif name == "REPEAT"
            int count := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            if #program.pool[inputs[1]].children == 0
                return Flow()
            for: 1 <= number <= count
                repcounts = repcounts.append(number)
                Flow | error result := .run_list(inputs[1])
                repcounts = repcounts[:<#repcounts - 1]
                signal := try result
                if signal.kind != 0
                    return signal
        elif name == "FOR"
            variable := program.pool[inputs[0]].text
            int start := try .evaluate(inputs[1])
            int finish := try .evaluate(inputs[2])
            if #program.pool[inputs[3]].children == 0
                .make_variable(variable, finish)
                return Flow()
            step := if start <= finish then 1 else -1
            value := start
            while true
                .make_variable(variable, value)
                Flow signal := try .run_list(inputs[3])
                if signal.kind != 0
                    return signal
                if value == finish
                    break
                value += step
        elif name == "WHILE"
            while (try .evaluate(inputs[0])) != 0
                Flow signal := try .run_list(inputs[1])
                if signal.kind != 0
                    return signal
        elif name == "IF"
            if (try .evaluate(inputs[0])) != 0
                return .run_list(inputs[1])
        elif name == "IFELSE"
            int condition := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            return .run_list(inputs[if condition != 0 then 1 else 2])
        elif name == "TEST"
            int value := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            environments[-1].test_result = if value != 0 then 1 else 0
        elif name == "IFTRUE" or name == "IFFALSE"
            value := environments[-1].test_result
            if value < 0
                return logo_error(command.line, command.spelling + " without TEST")
            if (value == 1) == (name == "IFTRUE")
                return .run_list(inputs[0])
        elif name == "STOP"
            return Flow(1)
        elif name == "OUTPUT"
            return Flow(2, try .evaluate(inputs[0]))
        elif name == "MAKE" or name == "LOCALMAKE" or name == "LOCAL"
            variable := program.pool[inputs[0]].text
            int value := if name == "LOCAL" then 0 else try .evaluate(inputs[1])
            if name == "MAKE"
                .make_variable(variable, value)
            else
                .environments[-1].variables.set(variable, value)
        elif name == "TRACE"
            procedure_name := program.pool[inputs[0]].text
            if not has_text(traced, procedure_name)
                traced = traced.append(procedure_name)
        elif name == "UNTRACE"
            procedure_name := program.pool[inputs[0]].text
            string[] kept := []
            for entry := traced[]
                if entry != procedure_name
                    kept = kept.append(entry)
            traced = kept
        elif name == "SEED"
            int value := try .evaluate(inputs[0])
            if value < 1
                return logo_error(command.line, command.spelling + " doesn't like {value} as input")
            random_state = value
        elif name == "PRINT"
            string[] texts := []
            for input := inputs[]
                texts = texts.append(try .print_item(input))
            emit(texts.join(" "))
        return Flow()

    void .run()
        match .run_list(program.top)
            Flow signal
                emit("TURTLE {turtle_x} {turtle_y} {heading} " + pen_state + " " + pen_character)
                write_canvas()
            error failure
                emit(failure.message)
                remaining := #environments - 1
                while remaining > 0
                    name := environments[remaining].procedure_name
                    nat count := 1
                    remaining -= 1
                    while remaining > 0 and environments[remaining].procedure_name == name
                        count += 1
                        remaining -= 1
                    emit("  in " + name + (if count == 1 then "" else " x{count}"))

void run_program(string name, SourceLine[] source)
    emit("PROGRAM " + name)
    parser := Parser()
    match .parser.build(source)
        BuiltProgram program
            runtime := Runtime(program)
            .runtime.run()
        error failure
            emit(failure.message)

void read_programs()
    line := ""
    name := ""
    nat number := 0
    SourceLine[] source := []
    while true
        match scan(&line)
            void
                void
            error failure
                break
        number += 1
        if line == "#EOF"
            run_program(name, source)
            break
        if line.starts_with("#PROGRAM ")
            if name != ""
                run_program(name, source)
            name = line[9:]
            source = []
        else
            source = source.append(SourceLine(number, line))

read_programs()
